title: BaseBoost
description: Experience the rush of enhanced gameplay with BaseBoost, a carefully curated Minecraft modpack designed to supercharge your performance while staying true to the charm of vanilla Minecraft.
body:
Experience the rush of enhanced gameplay with BaseBoost, a carefully curated Minecraft modpack designed to supercharge your performance while staying true to the charm of vanilla Minecraft.

This lightweight modpack focuses on:

Performance Enhancements: Boost your FPS and enjoy smoother gameplay with optimization mods tailored for maximum efficiency on all systems.

Vanilla+ Features: Discover subtle yet impactful additions that enrich the vanilla experience, from quality-of-life improvements to minor gameplay tweaks that feel right at home in Minecraft.
Whether you're a seasoned builder, a redstone enthusiast, or a survival adventurer, BaseBoost delivers an exhilarating balance of performance and simplicity. Get ready to play Minecraft like never before—faster, smoother, and just a little more exciting
